hook.why: A billionaire is humiliated by a woman who thinks he's a valet. Status violation plus a secret identity in the first frame.

shots.visual: A black tie gala ballroom under crystal chandeliers. A woman's hand in a silver sequined sleeve tilts a champagne flute over the head of a handsome valet in a red vest. Champagne pours over his hair and runs down his face and collar. He does not move or look away. His eyes stay calm, looking straight ahead. Behind him, soft and out of focus, guests laugh and hold up phones seen only from the back. Slow push in toward his face.
shots.light: warm chandelier top light, gold rim on his wet hair, cool bounce from the room at the frame edges
shots.sounds: champagne splashing on hair, a sharp gasp from the crowd, laughter building, phone camera shutter clicks, gala murmur, a string quartet stopping mid note
shots.out: cut on the splash sound into C02

shots.speaker: VIVIAN
shots.visual: Close up of a glamorous platinum blonde woman in a silver sequined gown holding an empty champagne flute at a black tie gala, three-quarter toward camera, looking down at someone just off camera.
shots.light: warm key from camera left, diamonds catching light, chandelier bokeh behind
shots.sounds: bright, sweet, mocking upper-class voice, close and clear, crowd laughter behind, gala room tone
shots.acting: Before the first word her chin lifts and her eyes drop to him. On 'Oops' one corner of her red lip curls and her brows rise in fake innocence. On 'Tip's included' she tilts the empty flute toward him. After the last word she holds the small cruel closed-lip smile for a beat and lowers the glass. Delivery: light, sweet and sing-song on top, a cold flat drop on 'included', unhurried.

shots.visual: Continuation of the same shot: the platinum blonde woman in a silver sequined gown is silent, mouth closed, she holds her small cruel smile, lowers the empty flute and turns her head slightly toward the laughing guests. Locked off camera, framing stays exactly as in the first frame, no cut, no zoom, nobody else enters the frame.
shots.light: warm key from camera left, diamonds catching light, chandelier bokeh behind
shots.sounds: crowd laughter, gala room tone
shots.out: cut on her head turn into C03B

shots.visual: Extreme close up of the valet, champagne dripping from his hair down his face. He slowly lifts his eyes straight into the lens, completely calm. A single drop falls from his jaw. He breathes once, steady. Locked off camera.
shots.light: gold chandelier rim, wet highlights on real skin with visible pores
shots.sounds: the crowd fades to a muffled hum, a single drip, a low cello note begins

shots.visual: Champagne droplets drift and rise across the frame, catching gold light, turning into falling gold confetti as the camera lifts up and away in one continuous move, revealing a glass skyscraper lobby party far below: a champagne tower, gold confetti, a giant glowing blank LED wall with no text.
shots.light: gold light catching every droplet, then warm amber party light
shots.sounds: a soft rising whoosh, the cello note swells, the roar of a party fades in, a confetti cannon pop, glasses clinking
shots.out: match transform, the time jump is carried by the move and the card
